integrity_note: All hypotheses and normalizations are stated in RESULT.md. The independent audit is not performed. The checker verifies selected finite fields but the general proof is algebraic.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the planar cubic graph together with its tangent at the origin over odd finite fields; no arbitrary-line, characteristic-two, weighted-extremizer, or higher-moment statement is made. Elliptic trace is exact but may not admit a uniform elementary formula.
title: Elliptic fourth-moment resonance for a finite-field cubic and its tangent line
